startCard.wish: Twenty-five years, one whole galaxy, all for you. May this year bring your master's degree, a little more rest, and every good thing your students already know you deserve. Tap below and let the stars carry you away. 💫

phrases: May all your wishes come true

loveCards.name: Happy 25th
loveCards.msg: Twenty-five looks wonderful on you - a whole quarter-century of being kind, bright, and impossible not to love. Here's to the next chapter.

loveCards.name: Almost a Master
loveCards.msg: All those late nights, readings and drafts are about to have letters after your name. So proud of you - go collect that degree.

loveCards.name: To the teacher
loveCards.msg: You spend your days helping other people find the right words. Today, let someone find them for you: you are appreciated, more than your students could ever say.

loveCards.name: Cap and gown soon
loveCards.msg: The walk across the stage is so close now. Whatever comes after graduation, you have more than earned it.

loveCards.name: Make a wish
loveCards.msg: Close your eyes, blow out all twenty-five candles, and wish big. If anyone deserves for it to come true, it's you.

loveCards.name: One in a billion
loveCards.msg: Smart, patient, and genuinely good - that combination is rare. Happy birthday to someone the world got lucky with.

loveCards.name: Your students are lucky
loveCards.msg: Somewhere out there, a kid learned to love English because of you. That's a real legacy - and you're only 25.

loveCards.name: This year
loveCards.msg: A new age, a new degree, and a fresh page. May 25 bring you good news, good people, and time to actually rest.

loveCards.name: In case no one said it
loveCards.msg: You are loved, you are enough, and you are doing better than you think. Happy birthday - and breathe, you've earned this day.

loveCards.name: Keep shining
loveCards.msg: You light up classrooms and group chats and every room you walk into. Never lose that. Have the brightest year yet.
